title: Food order
goal: Build a food ordering web app. The server has two shops, each with a menu: "Noodle House" sells "Beef noodles" for 8 and "Dumplings" for 5; "Tea Bar" sells "Milk tea" for 3 and "Green tea" for 2. The page first lists the shops as buttons labelled with the shop name. Clicking a shop shows its menu: each dish as "DISH: $PRICE" with a button labelled "Add DISH". The page shows the cart total as "Total: $N", starting at "Total: $0". A button labelled "Place order" stores the order on the server with its dishes and total, empties the cart and shows "Order placed". Stored orders are listed as "Order 1: $N", "Order 2: $N", in the order placed, and are shown when the page loads. Orders are kept when the server restarts.
